title: Ivy
author: John Gruber
summary: My thanks to Semantical for sponsoring DF last week to promote Ivy, the to-do list that ends. Typical to-do lists run forever. Ivy runs for one day. The concept is delightfully simple, but very effective. Each morning you make of list of things to do today, adding new items or pulling from a list of “ideas”.
